_comment: LABELLED GROUND TRUTH for the verification graph. Every case here is REAL — drawn from the
2026-07-24/25 fabrication sweep — and each records an actual outcome, not a synthetic example.
`shouldFlag: true`  = a genuine defect a check MUST catch (guards against false negatives).
`shouldFlag: false` = a CORRECT record a check must NOT flag (guards against false positives).
Every shouldFlag:false case is one my own matcher got wrong at some point during the sweep and
would have destroyed real data. They exist so a future change to a matcher cannot silently
reintroduce the same error: the graph runner asserts against these before trusting any check.

pmid-author-match.why: NFD folding: stored form drops the accent. Flagged in the first pass; would have condemned a correct CJC-1295 citation.
NFD does NOT decompose ø — needs explicit transliteration.
A >2-char surname guard excluded Ng, Wu, Lu, El — all real surnames.
The year regex extracted 2001 from a trial protocol code, faking a 24-year error.
The study field is not always an author; it may be a journal or a descriptive label.

pmid-author-match.authors: International Recombinant Human Chorionic Gonadotropin Study Group
pmid-author-match.why: Consortium authorship never matches a person-shaped label.
REAL defect found and fixed: lactoferricin cited an 18-year-wrong year.

doi-extraction.why: Elsevier/Lancet ids contain parentheses. A [^)]+ regex truncated 47 real DOIs here.
This exact DOI is the RETRACTED Shi 2022 meta-analysis; truncation hid it from the retraction gate.
An unbalanced trailing paren from prose must still be stripped.

nct-acronym-match.why: REAL near-miss: stem matching paired REDEFINE CVOT with REDEFINE 3 — different trials.
Both SYNCHRONIZE-1 and -CVOT matched SYNCHRONIZE-2 before exact matching was required.
Registry acronyms carry ™ and spacing variants; these are the SAME trial.

nct-drug-match.why: NCT03856047 IS the real cagrilintide Phase 2; CT.gov lists it under the Novo development code.
19 genuine tb-500 trials were flagged wrong-drug because the alias list lacked these forms.
REAL defect: a degarelix prostate-cancer trial was stored as cerebrolysin's CARS stroke trial.
REAL defect: a sickle-cell pain trial stored as an hCG follicular-maturation study.

title-match.why: REAL defect: 3 of 4 words shared, but the DISTINGUISHING word differs — book front matter cited as a peptide article.
REAL defect: publishing boilerplate carried the similarity score; the subject is different.

title-match.stored: The Peptide Drug ACTH(4-7)PGP (Semax) Suppresses mRNA Transcripts
title-match.real: Пептидный препарат АКТГ(4-7)PGP (семакс) подавляет транскрипцию генов
title-match.why: Russian original vs its English translation — same paper.

title-match.stored: Tirzepatide versus Semaglutide in Type 2 Diabetes
title-match.real: Tirzepatide versus Semaglutide Once Weekly in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes
title-match.why: SURPASS-2; stored form omits a clause.

title-match.stored: Dhillo WS, et al. J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2005;90(12):6609-6615
title-match.real: Kisspeptin-54 stimulates the hypothalamic-pituitary gonadal axis in human males
title-match.why: Landmark kisspeptin paper with NO stored title. Title matching alone would delete it; author+year confirms it.

publication-type.storedTitle: Targeted apoptosis of senescent cells restores tissue homeostasis
publication-type.realTitle: Targeted Apoptosis of Senescent Cells Restores Tissue Homeostasis in Response to Chemotoxicity and Aging
publication-type.why: FOXO4-DRI paper (Baar, Cell 2017). A 'Comment' pubtype can mean someone commented ON it.

publication-type.storedTitle: Dysplastic nevi and melanoma following use of Melanotan II
publication-type.why: A case report is a legitimate source for a safety observation.

quantitative-claims.why: 1 - 0.74 = 26%. A correct derivation, not a fabrication.

quantitative-claims.source: hazard ratio [HR] for recurrence or death, 0·56
quantitative-claims.why: Lancet/NEJM house style uses a MIDDLE DOT for decimals, defeating a \d\.\d regex.
Writers round; a rounded figure is still a correct citation.

quantitative-claims.source: A receptor in pituitary and hypothalamus
quantitative-claims.why: 677 is part of a compound name, not a quantity.

quantitative-claims.claim: 18-35% reduction in infarct size in rabbit and sheep models
quantitative-claims.source: reduced infarct size in an in vivo sheep model by 15% ... by 38% to 42% in isolated guinea pig hearts
quantitative-claims.why: REAL defect found and fixed: wrong numbers AND wrong animal models.

quantitative-claims.source: EC50 of 0.379 nM at GIPR versus 0.617 nM at GLP-1R

estimand.why: REAL defect in 13 places: efficacy estimand headlined over the published treatment-regimen figure.
23% is the CagriSema arm and 25.5% the tirzepatide comparator — not a contradiction.

relevance-filter.why: REAL defect: the NASA alias matched a maser paper and a Mars magnetosphere study.

relevance-filter.text: Automated External Defibrillator Pad Application Before EMS Arrival
relevance-filter.why: REAL defect: AED matched defibrillators and antiepileptic drugs.

relevance-filter.text: extension of the vascularized extensor digitorum longus
relevance-filter.why: REAL defect: EDL matched a leg muscle.

relevance-filter.text: OX40-OX40L Co-Stimulatory Pathway as a Shared Driver of Immune Persistence
relevance-filter.why: REAL defect: PubMed degrades an unmatched quoted phrase to loose term matching and returns confident noise.

relevance-filter.text: Real-world treatment satisfaction with once-weekly tirzepatide

mdx-safety.why: REAL defect: MDX parses <0 as a JSX tag; this failed the build with 0 pages emitted.

mdx-safety.input: title: AOD-9604: No Published Human Evidence
mdx-safety.why: REAL defect: an unquoted colon makes YAML read a nested mapping; 3 files became unparseable.
